sn35.204:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave aniccam atītaṃ || Yad aniccaṃ tam dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā tam Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtam sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Sotam aniccaṃ || || Ghānam aniccaṃ || || Jivhā aniccā || || Kāyo anicco || || Mano anicco atīto || yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || ||
